discovery.auth: api_key — `Authorization: ApiKey <public_key>:<secret_key>` (secret required for charge-incurring order requests; live + test-mode keys active simultaneously)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by the auditor.
auth: 1. Create a Kite account → credentials section: public API key + secret key (test + live)
2. `Authorization: ApiKey <public_key>:` for reads; append the secret for order requests
3. Add a card in billing to be charged for orders

endpoints.purpose: create a print order (jobs with template_id + assets, shipping address)

reference.limits: Not published. - Secret key on charge-incurring calls - Test mode never ships / charges

fields.name: api_key_pair
fields.help: Your Kite API key and secret key joined by a colon, exactly as the Authorization header expects them: <public_key>:<secret_key> (dashboard > credentials). The secret key is required for order requests, which are then charged to the card on your Kite account; test-mode keys never create real products.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists one order ({meta{total_count}, objects[]}), which needs the key and secret.

create_order.note: Places a print order charged to the card on your Kite account (secret key in the Authorization header; live keys create and ship real products). `shipping_address` uses Kite's address keys {recipient_name, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, county_state, postcode, country_code (ISO-3, e.g. GBR)} plus `phone` (customer_phone, required by Kite) and `email` (customer_email); `items` are Kite jobs [{template_id, assets[image URLs], options, shipping_class}] - the shipping class is per job, so `shipping_option` is not sent. Answers {print_order_id}.

get_order.note: GET /v4.0/order/{order_id}: {order_id, status, dispatch_status (e.g. In Print Queue, Dispatched), time_submitted, time_processed, test_order, jobs[{job_id, status, shipped_time, template{id, name}}]}. No tracking number is documented on the order.

track.note: Per-job production status of the order (jobs[{job_id, status, shipped_time, template}]); carrier tracking numbers are not part of the documented response.

not_offered.list_products: The docs show GET /v4.1/template/?limit=10 only as an authentication example without documenting its response; products are the template_ids listed in the ordering sections.
not_offered.get_product: No documented single-product endpoint; product identifiers and options are documented as template_id tables per product family.
not_offered.quote_shipping: GET /v4.0/shipping_methods/{template_id} answers shipping_regions keyed by Kite region codes (e.g. ROW) with shipping_classes[{class_name, costs[{amount, currency}]}]; the vocabulary's country cannot select the region.

evidence: host api.kite.ly: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
